An [[Local year|semiannual]] '''period''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] when the planet<ref name="FOTJ:A">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> [[Orbit/Legends|moving]] in a figure-eight trajectory<ref name="geo">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> passed directly between its two [[Star/Legends|stars]], [[Adega Prime]] and [[Adega Besh]]. Blasted by radiant energy from opposite sides, the planet went several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] without a night. Planetary [[Temperature/Legends|temperatures]] skyrocketed at this time, evaporating most of the surface [[Water/Legends|water]] and covering the entire world in [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]].<ref name="FOTJ:A" />
